remarks: *** Highest and Best is due today, 7/22/24 at 6pm. ***   Welcome to this beautifully renovated and spacious townhome conveniently located in the lovely Glenbrook area. With 2 oversized bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, it provides ample space and comfort for everyone. Enjoy the walk-out lower level with a wood burning fireplace and full bath that will surely please your overnight guests. Upon entering the home, you are greeted with all new LVP flooring throughout and elegant crown molding. This home boasts a brand new modern kitchen with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances and breakfast bar that opens to the dining room perfect for family gatherings. The living room has a newly renovated floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace that leads to an expansive oversized deck perfect for summer nights. Upstairs you will find two oversized bedrooms, ample closets and two full baths. The lower level has multi-functional purposes for an office, guest bedroom or family room. Newly installed barn doors over the laundry area and access to the attached garage completes it. Outside boasts beautiful plantings, blooming hydrangeas and a pool area tucked away so peacefully you will forget you are minutes from the vibrant downtown Stamford and all it has to offer.
